{{Quote|I used to be a merchant lord. My entire battlefield was in trade negotiations. I was able to pull a faster trick than even the great Lando Calrissian. At one time I thought I could sell to Jawas&mdash;look at how I've changed.|Bornan Thul|<ref name="Emperor's Plague" />}}
[[Bornan Thul]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a former [[Noble/Legends|noble]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the co-owner of [[Bornaryn Trading]], elder brother of [[Tyko Thul]], the husband of [[Aryn Dro Thul]], and the father of [[Raynar Thul]].

==Biography==
Bornan Thul originally met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in about 10 BBY on Alderaan. Solo was working as a pilot for the priests of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] under the alias of [[Han Solo/Legends|Vykk Draygo]]. Solo had put into Alderaan for repairs after being attacked by pirates, and during his layover met Thul in a college cafe, along with Thul's then girlfriend Aryn Dro. Thul didn't like Solo, as he made a flirtatious move on Aryn, telling her of how he'd escaped the pirate attack. Thul anxiously hurried off from the cafe with Aryn in tow, preventing Solo from furthering his cheeky advances.

Bornan had come into possession of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] that he was supposed to deliver to [[Diversity Alliance]] leader [[Nolaa Tarkona]] at a trade conference. However, he discovered what was in the navicomputer: the location of a plague warehouse. Horrified, he went into hiding, and Tarkona hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to find him.

Bornan eluded capture for months, and at last visited the plague warehouse with the intent to destroy it. Unfortunately, he did not have enough ammo and had to leave. On the way back, he was ambushed by bounty hunters, and his ship was damaged.

After being rescued by [[Zekk]], Bornan revealed that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] (actually [[Ailyn Vel]] having her father's identity) had sliced into his ship's navicomputer and gotten a hold of the coordinates of the plague warehouse.

After recording an encrypted message to his wife explaining their plan, Bornan, Raynar, Zekk, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], and [[Lowbacca]] gathered up some explosives and went to the warehouse with the intent to destroy it. They were almost finished wiring when Diversity Alliance ships showed up. In the ensuing confrontation with Tarkona in the warehouse, some of the plague canisters were broken, releasing viruses that included a disease aimed at Humans.

Bornan was infected and closed himself in a sealed room to keep from spreading the deadly plague. He stopped [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]], programmed to protect Bornan, from breaking down the door and ordered him to protect his son. Telling Raynar how proud he was, Bornan ordered his son, the droid, and Zekk to escape the asteroid and complete his unfinished work- to destroy the storehouse and the terrible biological weapons within.
